_note: REAL citizen-science records from Earthwatch Europe FreshWater Watch (public ArcGIS view); source and licence note below.

dataset.label: Real citizen science: FreshWater Watch volunteers near Toulouse and in central Portugal
dataset.banner: Real volunteer observations from Earthwatch Europe's FreshWater Watch (open access, no formal licence; attribution Earthwatch Europe) within about 50 km of Toulouse and in central Portugal (Aveiro, Figueira da Foz; 40-55 km from Coimbra): one volunteer campaign in March 2023 plus a few other visits, single visits per site. Only fields whose meaning matches StreamFHIR indicators are scored; kit bands are notes. For real citizen data a photo counts only after a reviewer's photo check. Each site is shown as of its own visit date.
